'''Gelgelar Free Port''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]], an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==History==
[[File:GelgelarFreePortMap-PlattStarport.png|thumb|left|150px|Gelgelar Free Port overhead map.]]

It was constructed on rare dry ground, a hill rising from the Gelgelar swamps. Its history dated back to about [[250 BBY/Legends|250 BBY]], when a group of misfits settled Gelgelar.

The unofficial mayor of Gelgelar Free Port was [[Loro Ecls]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] administrator. He and his family also owned the [[Nofre Repair Bay]] and [[Gelgelar Outfitters]]. Competition to Ecls came in the form of [[Fenn's Landing]], a [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] owned by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slerog Fenn]].

The main [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was the [[Slippery Gelgelar Eel]], near the [[Shrine of Kooroo]] and [[Red Threxa's Boarding House]].

Clouds of [[shvash gas]] floated through Gelgelar Free Port from time to time, a mildly noxious vapor, but one which was also bottled for off-world export. Also sold by local swamp farmers was [[vohis mold]], a food flavoring.
